title: Saratov Engels Airfield, 6 December 1959 – aerial reconnaissance photo with inset
description: Aerial reconnaissance photograph of a Soviet airfield showing long runways, parking aprons and adjacent buildings, with an enlarged inset at left bearing small label tags on parked aircraft and a north arrow at lower right. Captioned "Saratov Engels Airfield, 6 December 1959." Accompanying Chapter 4 text (page 165) discusses the Senate missile-gap hearings and Dulles's push for more overflights along railroad lines to locate SS-6 ICBM sites.
